features.name: historical_delay_seconds
features.description: route-level expanding mean delay, STRICTLY prior service_dates only (shift(1))
features.missing_value_behavior: XGBoost: pass NaN through natively (its split-finding algorithm learns a default direction for missing values, no imputation needed). Random Forest (via the existing sklearn preprocessing pipeline): impute with a TRAIN-fit median/most-frequent value plus an explicit missing-indicator column, per the established synthetic-pipeline discipline (src/preprocessing) -- never impute with a fixed global constant computed across train+val+test.
features.leakage_status: none by construction -- shift(1) before any expanding/rolling window, verified by test
features.meaning: route-level expanding mean delay, strictly prior service_dates

features.leakage_status: none by construction -- shift(1) before any expanding/rolling window, verified by test
features.meaning: route-level 7-day rolling mean delay, strictly prior service_dates

features.name: historical_reliability
features.description: 1 - route-level expanding disruption rate, STRICTLY prior service_dates only; NaN if the label policy is not active (no threshold to compute a disruption rate with)
features.data_source: MBTA LAMP delay_seconds + frozen label policy (src.ingestion.historical_features)
features.missing_value_behavior: XGBoost: pass NaN through natively (its split-finding algorithm learns a default direction for missing values, no imputation needed). Random Forest (via the existing sklearn preprocessing pipeline): impute with a TRAIN-fit median/most-frequent value plus an explicit missing-indicator column, per the established synthetic-pipeline discipline (src/preprocessing) -- never impute with a fixed global constant computed across train+val+test.
features.leakage_status: none by construction -- same shift(1) discipline, verified by test
features.meaning: 1 - route-level expanding disruption rate, strictly prior service_dates
